vulnerability: Broken Function Level Authorization / Privilege Escalation in PUT /teams/:id/members/:uid

six_constraints_implemented.1_admin_or_owner_only: Requester verified as team owner or member with admin role; returns 403 FORBIDDEN if unauthorized.
six_constraints_implemented.2_no_self_modification: Returns 403 FORBIDDEN with message 'Cannot modify your own role.' if callerId === targetUserId.
six_constraints_implemented.3_role_enum_validation: Enforces allowedRoles ['admin', 'member', 'viewer', 'owner']; returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR on superadmin, empty strings, or arbitrary input.
six_constraints_implemented.4_admin_cannot_promote_to_owner: Returns 403 FORBIDDEN if an admin attempts to assign target role 'owner'. Only owners can promote to owner.
six_constraints_implemented.5_audit_logging: Invokes recordAuditEvent on every successful role update capturing teamId, action 'member.role_updated', actorId, targetUserId, oldRole, and newRole.
six_constraints_implemented.6_thirteen_test_cases: Implemented all 13 required test cases in tests/member_role_security.test.js with 100% pass rate.
